style: Third-person open-world game cutscene look, live-action cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, steady game-camera motion, real-time playback, no anime, no illustration

world.name: Kasumi East floor
world.lock: Fictional open-plan office called Kasumi East: beige fabric cubicle partitions, light oak desks, grey carpet aisles, morning fluorescent tubes mixed with cool east window light, a few rubber plants, plain office doorways, blank badges, no readable letters on any surface

mio.lock: 27-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, shoulder-length black hair with a small matte clip on the right, cream blouse, navy pencil skirt, sheer black tights, low black block heels, a beige canvas tote on one shoulder, a navy lanyard with a blank white badge, tired calm morning expression, natural makeup

aoki.lock: Japanese man in his mid 40s, adult face, short black hair, navy security vest over a white shirt, sometimes a dark necktie, dark trousers, black office shoes, a blank white name badge with no letters on the vest, a clipboard in one hand, bored calm morning expression

kuroki.lock: Japanese man in his late 40s, short black hair, thin metal glasses, charcoal suit jacket, white shirt, a dark necktie, black office shoes, looks at papers, unhurried

nana.lock: 29-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, short brown bob, pale blue blouse, grey slacks, sits at a desk with a mug, mild morning expression

beats.place: Open-plan aisle at morning, a beige cubicle partition at the left, grey carpet running toward a window wall
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile to the aisle, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio crouches in profile beside the cubicle partition, knees chest neck and face all aimed down the aisle, tote on her shoulder, while Aoki walks toward her down the aisle with a clipboard; nobody else is in frame
beats.sfx: HVAC hum, distant keyboard taps, one soft footstep on carpet
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

beats.place: The same open-plan aisle, beige cubicle partitions, grey carpet, morning fluorescent light
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left at shoulder height, a half-step closer on the tote swing, then holding as Aoki sits
beats.action: Mio rises from the squat and swings the beige canvas tote in a short arc so the bag bottom hits Aoki's left shoulder and upper chest at walking-and-hit pace, arriving on Picture 2 with the tote pressed into his vest, his torso folding, the clipboard slipping. Mio is already past the squat
beats.sfx: Canvas thud, clipboard clack on carpet, HVAC hum
beats.music: Bass holds; one taiko hit on the tote contact

beats.place: A plain beige corridor wall beside a slightly open office doorway, grey carpet, morning fluorescent light
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile pressed to the doorframe, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio stays in profile against the corridor wall, pressed to the doorframe so the frame hides most of her; knees chest neck and face all aimed into the inner office. Kuroki stays seated at the inner desk looking down at papers, not at her; both stay in these spots
beats.sfx: Quiet corridor, paper rustle from the inner room, HVAC
beats.music: Bass holds; a sparse tick on the downbeat

beats.place: Inside the small inner office: a wood desk, a black rolling chair, morning window light, the doorway behind Mio
beats.camera: Third-person camera just inside the doorway at Mio's left shoulder, holding on Kuroki's chair as it rolls back
beats.action: Mio steps in and slams a stack of blank copy paper into Kuroki's left forearm and shoulder at walking-and-hit pace, arriving on Picture 2: blank sheets in the air between them, Kuroki rocking back in the chair at the desk
beats.sfx: Paper flutter, chair casters on carpet, HVAC
beats.music: Bass holds; a taiko hit on the paper contact

beats.place: The same inner office after the paper has settled, morning window light
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a slight push-in
beats.action: Kuroki sits at the inner desk with papers, looks at Mio in the doorway and speaks; Mio stands in the doorway and answers without turning back; both stay in these spots
beats.sfx: Quiet office, one paper settling, HVAC
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

beats.place: The same open-plan office, a light oak desk row with beige partitions, morning window light, the whole shot stays this desk row
beats.camera: Third-person camera in the aisle at shoulder height, Nana seated at left, Mio walking the aisle toward the far desks
beats.action: Mio walks the aisle past Nana's desk row; Nana sits with both hands on a white mug and looks up; both stay in this desk row
beats.sfx: Soft footsteps on carpet, a mug on wood, distant printer

beats.place: The same light oak desk row, Nana seated at left, an empty neighboring desk beside her, Mio standing in the aisle, morning window light
beats.camera: Third-person side two-shot at desk height, Nana at left, Mio close in the aisle at right, holding then following the mug
beats.action: Mio steps in close; the hanging beige tote knocks the white mug off Nana's desk at walking-and-hit pace, arriving on Picture 2: mug in the air toward the empty neighboring desk, a small brown coffee splash, Nana's torso folding back
beats.sfx: Ceramic slide, a small splash, chair casters, HVAC
beats.music: A short synth stab on the mug contact, then the bass

beats.place: Two light oak cubicles in a row, morning window light; the left desk is empty with a pushed-in chair, the right desk has a white mug
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Mio at the right-hand chair, the empty neighboring desk visible at left, holding still
beats.action: Mio sits in the right-hand chair, arriving on Picture 2: seated at this desk with the white mug on it, the tote on the carpet, the empty neighboring cubicle unused at left; she rests her right hand on the mouse and stays still
beats.sfx: Chair wheels on carpet, a mouse click, HVAC
beats.music: Bass returns with a slow taiko pattern
